_about: notes/staging before the A5 historical roll-out (2026-10-19); null = no note

old.035_teismas: Main picture: a courtroom seen from the gallery inside a tall interwar hall lit from above by skylights, marble columns with carved folk-pattern capitals along the walls: a judge in a dark robe at a raised bench, the gavel a single short wooden mallet held in his right fist, a clerk below, a witness at a stand, lawyers at two tables, the public on benches; a plain double-barred cross hangs on the wall behind the bench; the judge at the bench is the subject. Insets: the gavel on its block; the courthouse front — a heavy neoclassical corner block with a ground-floor arcade of round arches; the scales of justice.
old.048_ligonine: Main picture: a hospital building front with a red cross over the entrance, an ambulance with a red cross at the door, two orderlies in white carrying a stretcher, a nurse in a white cap; the building with the ambulance is the subject. Insets: a ward with a patient in bed and a doctor; a nurse pushing a wheelchair; a plain red cross in a circle.
old.055_bankas: Main picture: a bank hall — a cashier seen full-face through a counter grille, the grille clearly in front of her with the counter ledge below it, counting banknotes onto the ledge for a customer standing on the near side; the counter with its grille is the subject. Insets: the columned bank façade; a savings book stamped; coins stacked on the counter.
old.106_zaidejas: Main picture: a man and a woman player in plain jerseys and shorts on a football field, one dribbling the ball, the other running alongside; one glances toward the viewer. Insets: a basketball player shooting at a hoop; a chess player moving a piece; a volleyball player at the net.
old.107_sirgalius: A man and a woman spectator in a stadium stand holding a tricolour scarf up with both hands and shouting; one faces the viewer, the other looks at the pitch. Insets: a football pitch with players far below; a rattle and a scarf; a crowd of spectators.
old.113_gydytojas: Keep the small red cross on the clinic building or medical kit; one doctor facing the viewer, the other attending to a patient.
old.122_menininkas: A man and a woman artist painting at easels outdoors above a river, one turned to the viewer with brush raised, the other at work on the canvas. Insets: a palette and brushes; a box of paint tubes; a finished landscape canvas.
old.138_komanda: Main picture: a football team of eleven lined up in two rows, same green jerseys but every player different in height, build, hair and age, a coach in a tracksuit at the end, the goalkeeper in a different colour; two face the viewer, the rest look at the coach. Insets: a basketball team in a huddle; a rowing eight in a boat; a factory volleyball team with a trophy.
old.123_autorius: Main picture: a man and a woman author at a shared desk piled with manuscript pages — the woman an old woman in a dark dress with a pale headscarf tied under the chin, writing with a pen on loose sheets; the man lean and clean-shaven, in his forties, high forehead, hair swept back, in a dark suit and tie, at a typewriter pulling out a finished page; a shelf behind holds many copies of the same thick book with a blank spine. The writers at their desk are the subject. Insets: a hand correcting a typed page with a pen; a stack of bound manuscript with a ribbon; an open book on a reader's lap.
old.A2-0085: Main picture: a small window in a tiled station wall with a counter, a woman clerk behind the glass handing a ticket and change across, a traveller with a suitcase receiving it, two people queued behind. The window with the exchange of ticket and money is the subject. Insets: a punched ticket; the brass window counter with coins; the queue seen from behind.
old.A2-0645: Main picture: a town square from eye level — a wide open paved space, the town hall with a tower on the far side, a fountain, benches, people crossing diagonally, a trolleybus along one edge. The open paved space ringed by buildings is the subject. Insets: a market set up on the square; the fountain; pigeons on the paving.
old.A2-0649: Main picture: a post office hall — a row of counters with clerks behind glass, a woman weighing a parcel on a letter scale, a man licking a stamp, sacks of mail, a blue post box by the door. The counters with letters and parcels are the subject. Insets: the post box outside; a postman's bicycle with bags; a bundle of letters tied with string.
old.A2-0652: Main picture: a museum gallery — glass display cases with ancient pots, amber and a sword, paintings on the walls, visitors leaning to look, an elderly attendant on a chair in the corner. The exhibits in their cases are the subject. Insets: a museum façade with columns; a mammoth skeleton in a hall; a child pressing a nose to a case.
old.A2-0658: Main picture: a cemetery under old trees — rows of graves with wooden and stone crosses, candle lanterns, a woman kneeling to plant flowers on one, a small chapel. The graves with their crosses are the subject. Insets: a single cross with a lit candle; a wreath; a funeral procession at the gate.
old.A2-1282: Main picture: a café interior — small round tables with cups and plates of cakes, a counter with a coffee machine and a cake case, a waitress carrying a tray, a couple deep in talk at the window. The tables with their cups and cakes are the subject. Insets: a cup of coffee with a pastry; the café front with its awning; the cake case.
old.A2-1293: Main picture: a concert hall from the back of the stalls — a wide stage with a full orchestra, tiers of red seats filling, chandeliers, a conductor arriving. The great hall with its stage is the subject. Insets: a row of seats; a balcony; the hall façade with columns.
old.A2-0812: Main picture: a concert hall — an orchestra and choir on the stage, the conductor with his baton raised, the audience filling the rows below, music stands, chandeliers. The performers before the audience are the subject. Insets: a violinist bowing; a programme leaflet with a drawn lyre; applauding hands.
old.A2-1747: Main picture: a full orchestra on a concert stage — rows of violins, cellos, brass and timpani, music stands, the conductor with baton raised, every player mid-bow or mid-blow. The massed players under the conductor are the subject. Insets: a violin section close; the conductor from behind; a brass band in a park.
old.A2-1360: Main picture: a theatre — actors in period costume on a lit stage before a painted backdrop, footlights, the red curtain half drawn, rows of audience in the dark. The acted scene on the stage is the subject. Insets: a playbill frame left blank; an actor bowing; opera glasses.
old.A2-0782: Main picture: an engineer at a drawing board with a large technical drawing of a bridge (lines only), a slide rule and compasses in hand, a hard hat on the desk, a model girder beside him. The man at the technical drawing is the subject. Insets: the engineer in a hard hat at a building site pointing; the slide rule and compasses; a turbine on a drawing.
old.A2-0653: Main picture: a cinema hall from the back — rows of heads in seats, the big bright screen showing a scene of a galloping horse, the projector beam cutting the dark. The screen and the watching rows are the subject. Insets: the cinema façade with a poster frame (blank); a ticket torn in half; a projector with its reels.
old.A2-1326: Main picture: a postman in a uniform cap with a bulging shoulder bag handing letters to a woman at her garden gate, his bicycle leaning on the fence. The man delivering letters is the subject. Insets: letters going into a letterbox; the bag full of envelopes; the postman on his bicycle.
